title: Claude Code Agent Handoff
description: Versioned structured handoff emitted as the final message of every specialist agent. The lead treats this object as the interface; free-text outside the JSON is ignored for gating.

schema_version.description: Handoff contract version. Bump only on breaking field changes.

handoff_id.description: Unique id for this handoff (UUID or short trace id). Correlate parallel workstreams.

to.description: Intended recipient: usually 'lead', or another role name when chaining.

task_id.description: Stable id of the work item (matches shared task list when present).

status.description: Terminal state of this agent's work on the task.

confidence.description: Agent's calibrated confidence in the handoff claims (0–1).

summary.description: One or two sentences. MUST include a proof token: commit SHA, test count, file:line, or command that passed.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the handoff was produced.

payload.description: Role-specific body. Shape depends on from_role; see orchestration/handoff.md.
